scope_note: Covers the statutory process by which an integration joint board prepares, consults on, finalises, publishes and reviews its strategic plan, and the circumstances in which it must prepare a replacement plan. Confined to legislation (Acts and Scottish Statutory Instruments); case law and non-statutory guidance are out of scope in this mode.

steps.title: Identify the governing Act and the duty to prepare a strategic plan
steps.detail: Identify the primary Scottish legislation establishing integration joint boards and requiring them to prepare strategic plans, and set out what a strategic plan must contain and the period it covers.

steps.title: Establish the matters the board must consider when preparing a plan
steps.detail: Find the provisions setting out what the integration joint board must have regard to when preparing a strategic plan, including any statutory principles and any prescribed national outcomes, and any duty to consider the effect on neighbouring areas.

steps.title: Set out the consultative body and the staged preparation procedure
steps.detail: Find the provisions establishing the strategic planning group — its composition and how members are appointed and removed — and the sequence of proposals, drafts and consultations the board must follow before the plan can be finalised.

steps.title: Establish the publication requirements and any duty to provide information
steps.detail: Find the provisions requiring publication of the finalised plan and of any accompanying statement, and any duty on constituent authorities to supply information the board reasonably requires for preparing the plan.

steps.title: Set out the review cycle and the routes to a replacement plan
steps.detail: Find the provisions requiring periodic review of the plan's effectiveness — including the length of the review period and how it is calculated — what the board must have regard to and whom it must consult on review, and both the discretionary and the directed routes to preparing a replacement plan.

steps.title: Identify the subordinate legislation prescribing who must be consulted
steps.detail: Identify any Scottish Statutory Instrument prescribing the groups of persons to be consulted for the purposes of the strategic-plan provisions, and set out the prescribed groups and any conditions attaching to them.
